verses.original: Οὕτως ἡμᾶς λογιζέσθω ἄνθρωπος ὡς ὑπηρέτας Χριστοῦ καὶ οἰκονόμους μυστηρίων Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Houtōs hēmas logizesthō anthrōpos hōs hypēretas Christou kai oikonomous mystēriōn Theou
verses.literal: So then men ought to regard us as servants of Christ and stewards of the mysteries of God

verses.original: ὧδε λοιπὸν ζητεῖται ἐν τοῖς οἰκονόμοις ἵνα πιστός τις εὑρεθῇ
verses.transliteration: hōde loipon zēteitai en tois oikonomois hina pistos tis heurethē
verses.literal: Now . . . it is required of stewards - that they be found faithful

verses.original: Ἐμοὶ δὲ εἰς ἐλάχιστόν ἐστιν ἵνα ὑφ’ ὑμῶν ἀνακριθῶ ἢ ὑπὸ ἀνθρωπίνης ἡμέρας ἀλλ’ οὐδὲ ἐμαυτὸν ἀνακρίνω
verses.transliteration: Emoi de eis elachiston estin hina hyph’ hymōn anakrithō ē hypo anthrōpinēs hēmeras all’ oude emauton anakrinō
verses.literal: I care very little . . . however if I am judged by you or by any human court In fact I do not even judge myself

verses.original: οὐδὲν γὰρ ἐμαυτῷ σύνοιδα ἀλλ’ οὐκ ἐν τούτῳ δεδικαίωμαι ὁ δὲ ἀνακρίνων με Κύριός ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: ouden gar emautō synoida all’ ouk en toutō dedikaiōmai ho de anakrinōn me Kyrios estin
verses.literal: My conscience is clear . . . . . . but that does not vindicate me It is the Lord who judges me

verses.original: Ὥστε μὴ πρὸ καιροῦ τι κρίνετε ἕως ἂν ἔλθῃ ὁ Κύριος ὃς καὶ φωτίσει τὰ κρυπτὰ τοῦ σκότους καὶ φανερώσει τὰς βουλὰς τῶν καρδιῶν καὶ τότε ὁ ἔπαινος γενήσεται ἑκάστῳ ἀπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hōste mē pro kairou ti krinete heōs an elthē ho Kyrios hos kai phōtisei ta krypta tou skotous kai phanerōsei tas boulas tōn kardiōn kai tote ho epainos genēsetai hekastō apo tou Theou
verses.literal: Therefore judge nothing before the appointed time wait until the Lord comes He will bring to light what is hidden in darkness and will expose the motives of men’s hearts At that time each will receive his praise from God

verses.original: Ταῦτα δέ ἀδελφοί μετεσχημάτισα εἰς ἐμαυτὸν καὶ Ἀπολλῶν δι’ ὑμᾶς ἵνα ἐν ἡμῖν μάθητε τό Μὴ ὑπὲρ ἃ γέγραπται ἵνα μὴ εἷς ὑπὲρ τοῦ ἑνὸς φυσιοῦσθε κατὰ τοῦ ἑτέρου
verses.transliteration: Tauta de adelphoi meteschēmatisa eis emauton kai Apollōn di’ hymas hina en hēmin mathēte to Mē hyper ha gegraptai hina mē heis hyper tou henos physiousthe kata tou heterou
verses.literal: Brothers I have applied these things to myself and Apollos for your benefit . . . so that you may learn from us not to go beyond what is written Then you will not take pride in one man over another

verses.original: τίς γάρ σε διακρίνει τί δὲ ἔχεις ὃ οὐκ ἔλαβες εἰ δὲ καὶ ἔλαβες τί καυχᾶσαι ὡς μὴ λαβών
verses.transliteration: tis gar se diakrinei ti de echeis ho ouk elabes ei de kai elabes ti kauchasai hōs mē labōn
verses.literal: For who makes you so superior . . . What do you have that you did not receive And if you did receive it why do you boast as though you did not

verses.original: ἤδη κεκορεσμένοι ἐστέ ἤδη ἐπλουτήσατε χωρὶς ἡμῶν ἐβασιλεύσατε καὶ ὄφελόν γε ἐβασιλεύσατε ἵνα καὶ ἡμεῖς ὑμῖν συμβασιλεύσωμεν
verses.transliteration: Ēdē kekoresmenoi este ēdē eploutēsate chōris hēmōn ebasileusate kai ophelon ge ebasileusate hina kai hēmeis hymin symbasileusōmen
verses.literal: Already you have all you want Already you have become rich Without us you have become kings How I wish you really were kings so that we might be kings with you

verses.original: δοκῶ γάρ ὁ Θεὸς ἡμᾶς τοὺς ἀποστόλους ἐσχάτους ἀπέδειξεν ὡς ἐπιθανατίους ὅτι θέατρον ἐγενήθημεν τῷ κόσμῳ καὶ ἀγγέλοις καὶ ἀνθρώποις
verses.transliteration: dokō gar ho Theos hēmas tous apostolous eschatous apedeixen hōs epithanatious hoti theatron egenēthēmen tō kosmō kai angelois kai anthrōpois
verses.literal: For it seems to me that God has displayed us apostles at the end of the procession like prisoners appointed for death We have become a spectacle to the whole world to angels as well as to men

verses.original: Ἡμεῖς μωροὶ διὰ Χριστόν ὑμεῖς δὲ φρόνιμοι ἐν Χριστῷ ἡμεῖς ἀσθενεῖς ὑμεῖς δὲ ἰσχυροί ὑμεῖς ἔνδοξοι ἡμεῖς δὲ ἄτιμοι
verses.transliteration: Hēmeis mōroi dia Christon hymeis de phronimoi en Christō hēmeis astheneis hymeis de ischyroi hymeis endoxoi hēmeis de atimoi
verses.literal: We are fools for Christ but you are wise in Christ We are weak but you are strong You are honored but we are dishonored

verses.original: ἄχρι τῆς ἄρτι ὥρας καὶ πεινῶμεν καὶ διψῶμεν καὶ γυμνιτεύομεν καὶ κολαφιζόμεθα καὶ ἀστατοῦμεν
verses.transliteration: achri tēs arti hōras kai peinōmen kai dipsōmen kai gymniteuomen kai kolaphizometha kai astatoumen
verses.literal: To this very hour we are hungry and thirsty we are poorly clothed we are brutally treated we are homeless

verses.original: καὶ κοπιῶμεν ἐργαζόμενοι ταῖς ἰδίαις χερσίν λοιδορούμενοι εὐλογοῦμεν διωκόμενοι ἀνεχόμεθα
verses.transliteration: kai kopiōmen ergazomenoi tais idiais chersin loidoroumenoi eulogoumen diōkomenoi anechometha
verses.literal: We work hard . . . with our own hands When we are vilified we bless when we are persecuted we endure it

verses.original: δυσφημούμενοι παρακαλοῦμεν ὡς περικαθάρματα τοῦ κόσμου ἐγενήθημεν πάντων περίψημα ἕως ἄρτι
verses.transliteration: dysphēmoumenoi parakaloumen hōs perikatharmata tou kosmou egenēthēmen pantōn peripsēma heōs arti
verses.literal: when we are slandered we answer gently Up to this moment we have become the scum of the earth the refuse of the world

verses.original: Οὐκ ἐντρέπων ὑμᾶς γράφω ταῦτα ἀλλ’ ὡς τέκνα μου ἀγαπητὰ νουθετῶν
verses.transliteration: Ouk entrepōn hymas graphō tauta all’ hōs tekna mou agapēta nouthetōn
verses.literal: I am not writing this to shame you but to warn you as my beloved children

verses.original: ἐὰν γὰρ μυρίους παιδαγωγοὺς ἔχητε ἐν Χριστῷ ἀλλ’ οὐ πολλοὺς πατέρας ἐν γὰρ Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου ἐγὼ ὑμᾶς ἐγέννησα
verses.transliteration: ean gar myrious paidagōgous echēte en Christō all’ ou pollous pateras en gar Christō Iēsou dia tou euangeliou egō hymas egennēsa
verses.literal: Even if you have ten thousand guardians in Christ you do not have many fathers for in Christ Jesus I became your father . . . through the gospel

verses.original: παρακαλῶ οὖν ὑμᾶς μιμηταί μου γίνεσθε
verses.transliteration: parakalō oun hymas mimētai mou ginesthe
verses.literal: Therefore I urge you to imitate me

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο αὐτὸ ἔπεμψα ὑμῖν Τιμόθεον ὅς ἐστίν μου τέκνον ἀγαπητὸν καὶ πιστὸν ἐν Κυρίῳ ὃς ὑμᾶς ἀναμνήσει τὰς ὁδούς μου τὰς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ καθὼς πανταχοῦ ἐν πάσῃ ἐκκλησίᾳ διδάσκω
verses.transliteration: Dia touto auto epempsa hymin Timotheon hos estin mou teknon agapēton kai piston en Kyriō hos hymas anamnēsei tas hodous mou tas en Christō Iēsou kathōs pantachou en pasē ekklēsia didaskō
verses.literal: That is why . . . . . . I have sent you Timothy - my beloved and faithful child in the Lord He will remind you of my way of life in Christ Jesus which is exactly what I teach everywhere in every church

verses.original: Ὡς μὴ ἐρχομένου δέ μου πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐφυσιώθησάν τινες
verses.transliteration: Hōs mē erchomenou de mou pros hymas ephysiōthēsan tines
verses.literal: Some of you have become arrogant as if I were not coming to you

verses.original: ἐλεύσομαι δὲ ταχέως πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐὰν ὁ Κύριος θελήσῃ καὶ γνώσομαι οὐ τὸν λόγον τῶν πεφυσιωμένων ἀλλὰ τὴν δύναμιν
verses.transliteration: eleusomai de tacheōs pros hymas ean ho Kyrios thelēsē kai gnōsomai ou ton logon tōn pephysiōmenōn alla tēn dynamin
verses.literal: But I will come to you shortly if the Lord is willing and then I will find out not only what these arrogant people are saying but what power they have

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ ἐν λόγῳ ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀλλ’ ἐν δυνάμει
verses.transliteration: ou gar en logō hē basileia tou Theou all’ en dynamei
verses.literal: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of talk but of power

verses.original: τί θέλετε ἐν ῥάβδῳ ἔλθω πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἢ ἐν ἀγάπῃ πνεύματί τε πραΰτητος
verses.transliteration: ti thelete en rhabdō elthō pros hymas ē en agapē pneumati te prautētos
verses.literal: Which do you prefer Shall I come to you with a rod or in love and with a gentle spirit
